role_search_desc: Searching for your target group using the participant code.
role_admin_desc: Full access to all functions, data management, and user access control.
role_chief_desc: Access to results and the ability to edit contact information for group leaders.
role_viewer_desc: Ability to view mixing results and statistics without making changes.
feat_search_desc: By entering a unique code, users can find troop names, subcamps, leader names, and phone numbers.
feat_db_desc: Viewing tables with original (uploaded) groups and generated target groups. Filtering by subcamp is available.
feat_manage_desc: Quick search and edit of contact details for group leaders within a subcamp.
feat_import_desc: Uploading Excel files, running the distribution algorithm, and exporting results.
feat_tokens_desc: Generating access links for different roles (Admin, Subcamp Chief, Viewer).
